svg.title: Compact framed supporter arms — Forest Officer booklet; edition unresolved
svg.desc: The booklet and identification-card crops show compact supporter arms within a rounded square. The actual supplied PofBC PROVINCIAL_MARK.inner vector is preserved, including its own border and compact motto. The small sources do not establish the exact historical engraving or date; this reference does not date the cards or establish a modern edition. The flat dark field represents the booklet behind white ink; paper texture is excluded.
